title: Heat limits act on the 2 min CPU average: master status shows the latest sample and the mean
description: GY-3532: after two minutes of loop cycles over a fixture hwmon whose package holds 90-92C, master status shows the latest sample (92C) beside the 120 s mean (91C), and the waiting line names the mean: 'CPU averages 91C over 2 min; limit 85C'.

steps.name: master status shows the latest CPU sample, the 120 s mean and a waiting line naming the mean
